coverage_manifest.coverage_decision: All substantive article pages 202-205, all three figures, competing-interest statement, and all nine references included. Publisher notice excluded from synthesis.
omissions: No formal Methods section exists; design details are inferred only to the level directly apparent from the case-series report and are labeled as appraisal/inference where applicable.

findings: Case 2 D-dimer unit is preserved as printed ("ug/mL dL") rather than silently corrected.

extraction_limitations: This is a three-patient descriptive case series without a comparator group; atoms capture reported observations but do not establish incidence, causality, or treatment effectiveness.
The source has no formal Methods section; methodological details not explicitly reported were not invented.
Reference-list claims were not atomized as if they were primary results of this article.
Treatment exposures are recorded descriptively and must not be interpreted as evidence of benefit.
schema_gaps: The current LiteratureAtom schema has no dedicated case-report/case-series event timeline object, so related multi-measure clinical presentation panels are retained as OTHER or QUALITATIVE_RESULT atoms while central P/F ratios and event timing are structured as QUANTITATIVE_RESULT atoms.
